channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Mini book: Next-Gen Architecture Playbook: Insights and Patterns for the AI Era
item.description: This eMag examines how architects can lead with clarity in a rapidly evolving engineering world, distilling industry insights into field-tested practices for teams. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Presentation: From S3 to GPU in One Copy: Rethinking Data Loading for ML Training
item.description: Onur Satici explains how Vortex, an open-source columnar file format under the Linux Foundation, revolutionizes high-throughput data loading. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Shopify Introduces Gisting: Compressing LLM System Prompts into Learned Tokens
item.description: Shopify's engineering introduced gisting, a novel technique for compressing long LLM prompts into a smaller set of learned "gist" tokens, improving throughput and reducing inference cost. By Sergio De Simone (1 source: infoq)

item.title: How we make AI coding more cost efficient without sacrificing task quality
item.description: Why shorter outputs can cost more, and how GitHub Copilot reduces wasted work across the complete coding task. The post How we make AI coding more cost efficient without sacrificing task quality appeared first on The GitHub Blog . (1 source: githubblog)

item.title: Introducing context-aware vulnerability discovery and remediation with Cloudflare Managed Defense and OpenAI Daybreak models
item.description: Use production traffic and security signals to prioritize findings, prepare edge mitigations when safe, and propose code patches. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Run several agents at once
item.description: Learn how to run parallel agents in the GitHub Copilot app, and experience the moment it stops feeling scary and starts feeling powerful. (1 source: githubblog)

item.title: Decoding the new AI lingo: Loops, harnesses, squads, hill climbing… oh my!
item.description: From loop engineering to harnesses, squads, and open weights, the GitHub Podcast breaks down the AI terms showing up in developer conversations. The post Decoding the new AI lingo: Loops, harnesses, squads, hill climbing… oh my! (1 source: githubblog)
